# Bungee Jump Insurance

> Bungee Jump Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides specialized commercial insurance for bungee jump operators and extreme sports venues in all 50 states. Coverage lines: general liability (participant injury, premises, completed operations), participant accident & medical payments insurance, commercial property for jump towers and mobile cranes, workers' compensation for jump masters and rigging crews, umbrella / excess liability for high-limit venue contracts, and equipment breakdown insurance for bungee systems (winches, braking mechanisms, control electronics). A-rated carriers. 15-minute quotes, 2-hour claims response. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
